ja269:1.1: (Though) being endowed with beauty, pleasing and good-looking,
ja269:1.3: Those with rough voices are not dear,
ja269:1.4: in this world or the next.
ja269:2.1: Surely you must see this one, who is black, ugly, mottled with spots,
ja269:3.1: Therefore for the one of kind voice, a wise speaker, and not haughty,
ja269:3.3: Who explains both the Dhamma and its meaning,
